Thanks again for taking the time to demo Acme Health's intake flow today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Hi Samantha / Marissa —

Quick technical notes from our side on schema compliance, function/tool calling, and retries: 

1) JSON schema compliance testing
- We'll run a strict JSON Schema (draft-07) validator against the model output for patient_intake_v2. Our compliance metric = percentage of responses that fully validate without post-processing.
- For discrepant cases we'll include a categorized error list: missing required fields, wrong types, enum mismatch, extra unexpected properties.

2) Tool / function calling and structured outputs
- We support both: (a) direct structured generation (model outputs JSON text) and (b) function-calling (model returns arguments that our runtime maps to a function, guaranteeing parsing).
- For high-precision pipelines we recommend function-calling with a lightweight validation layer. If the function parse fails, the runtime can automatically retry up to N times with adjusted system prompts to enforce spacing/escape rules.

3) Retry/backoff policy (recommended)
- Try 1: initial call.
- Try 2: if schema fails but confidence > threshold, re-prompt with exact failing keys and a short example (we inject the schema snippet).
- Try 3: if still failing, escalate to a deterministic extraction fallback (rule-based extractor) and mark the case for human review.
- In our bench runs we'll surface effective retry rates and the marginal pass rate per retry.

4) Model recommendations for your quality/latency targets
- Start: quantized 7B (fast, cost-efficient). If p95 exceeds 1s or schema fail rate remains >5% even after retries, move to 13B non-quantized for production.

5) Deliverables for the eval run (what we'll deliver on 6/13)
- PDF: pass/fail rates by schema rule, per-retry uplift, representative failure examples.
- CSV: per-case outputs + validation error codes.
- Notebook link: exact prompt templates and seed examples (so you can reproduce).

I'll schedule the bench run once we get the schema and the 30-case edge set.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
